[Grifols](https://www.grifols.com/en/company) is a global healthcare company known for pioneering the plasma industry and manufacturing essential plasma-derived medicines. It operates one of the world's largest networks of plasma donation centers and provides critical biologic therapies, diagnostic tools, and hospital pharmacy technologies globally. [](https://www.grifols.com/en/what-we-do)

- **Plasma Collection:** Operates hundreds of donor centers worldwide to collect human blood plasma.

- **Plasma Medicines:** Produces vital therapies like immunoglobulins (IVIG), albumin, factor VIII for hemophilia, and alpha-1 antitrypsin.

- **Transfusion Safety:**

Develops blood typing, matching, and screening diagnostic systems to secure the global blood supply.

- **Hospital Solutions:** Supplies automated medical compounding systems and pharmacy tools for sterile drug mixing. [](https://www.grifols.com/en/what-we-do)

### Key Medical Focus Areas

- **Immunology:** Treating primary and secondary immune deficiencies.

- **Neurology & Pulmonology:** Managing rare genetic and chronic neurological/lung diseases.

- **Hepatology & Intensive Care:** Providing critical albumin and emergency care solutions. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grifols)
